description: Knowledge base of benchmark scores for recent open-weight AI models (1.5B-285B, official weights, current versions only).

criteria.notes: Official weights only (no GGUF/AWQ/FP8/bnb/LoRA/finetune/merge). Skip models superseded by a newer version of the same family/size (e.g. skip Qwen3.6-27B if 3.8-27B exists). Score source-of-truth: official model card / tech report first; other sources fill gaps with attribution. age_exemptions lists model_ids kept despite the release cutoff, on explicit request (each is still logged in its models.json notes).
